64: श्वेत-; HK: श्वेत-; KB 3, p. 1790-1791: श्वेत-) (see Hooker 4,
p. 243) = D. INNOXIA MILL. (Bpn, p. 317-320) = D. NILHUMMATU DUN.
(

, nr. 796); there is no agreement about the nomenclature of
the species of Datura: Hooker considers D. METEL LINN. and D.
FASTUOSA LINN. as separate species (vol. 4, p. 242-243), as well as
Cooke (vol. 2, p. 343-344), but a different classification is found in
Chopra: a) D. INNOXIA MILL. is a separate species, b) D. METEL LINN.
= D. FASTUOSA LINN. = D. ALBA NEES, and in IRM vol. 3, p. 14-15:
a) D. INNOXIA MILL. = D. METEL AUCTT. (NON LINN.), b) D. METEL
LINN. = D. FASTUOSA LINN. = D. ALBA NEES = D. FASTUOSA VAR.
ALBA (NEES) C. B. CLARKE; IRM 3, p. 16-19: the names धत्तूर and
धुस्तूर are applied to representatives of the genus Datura irrespective
of the species.
